high_rate_policy.stream_policy: 360 Hz source data is streamed, not stored relationally. Relational rows are bounded: inference <= 1/window, context <= 1/s, state & quality on change only, waveform preview <= max_preview_points per channel.

enforced_by: repository API exposes no update path for them
SQLite BEFORE UPDATE triggers abort any change

quality_events_policy: signal_quality_events rows are written on CHANGE of (ecg_quality, ppg_quality) only

restart_semantics.devices: reconstructed from devices row + scenario_id + frozen scenario contract; connection state starts DETACHED; history stays in device_connections
restart_semantics.sessions: terminal sessions unchanged; any persisted CREATED/DEVICE_READY/MONITORING/STOPPING session is set to FAILED at startup (never resumed)

waveform_previews_policy.decimation: deterministic bucket decimation; all-missing buckets stored as null; never 0
